Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics and phosphoproteomics experiments described in this study were used to generate basal molecular profiles of various cancer cell lines to serve as input features for a machine learning model (DRUML). The MS analysis itself was not a perturbation or differential study (e.g., treated vs untreated); rather, it was a profiling of multiple cell lines. While the study discusses drug sensitivity (AAC values), these were sourced from PharmacoDB or other repositories, not generated by treating the samples analyzed by MS in this specific experiment. Therefore, this is classified as an un-classified non-perturbation study.
